claims.statement: Cilium serves as the cluster's Container Network Interface with eBPF-based data plane, replacing kube-proxy entirely. It operates with Kubernetes-native IPAM, native routing mode for the 10.42.0.0/16 pod network, Maglev load balancing algorithm with Direct Server Return mode, and socket load balancing restricted to host namespace for optimal performance.

Cilium implements the Kubernetes Gateway API specification with two gateway instances using the cilium gatewayClass: an external gateway on 192.168.50.13 for public-facing services, and an internal gateway on 192.168.50.12 for cluster-internal services. Both support HTTP (port 80) and HTTPS (port 443) with wildcard hostname matching for *.SECRET_DOMAIN.

Cilium advertises LoadBalancer service IPs via L2 announcements enabled in configuration, providing LoadBalancer functionality in bare-metal environments without cloud provider integration by advertising IPs directly on the local network segment.

Cilium Egress Gateway is enabled and allows controlled egress traffic routing through designated nodes using CiliumEgressGatewayPolicy CRDs. Workloads like qBittorrent route external traffic through specific egress IPs (e.g., 192.168.50.10) while excluding cluster-internal CIDRs to ensure only true external traffic uses the gateway.

Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) provides secure inbound access without opening external ports, running image docker.io/cloudflare/cloudflared:2026.7.3 with HTTP/2 protocol. The tunnel routes traffic for SECRET_DOMAIN and *.SECRET_DOMAIN to the external Cilium Gateway, with the tunnel endpoint registered as a CNAME DNS record pointing to the Cloudflare Tunnel unique ID.

External DNS management uses Cloudflare provider with sync policy, watching CRD (DNSEndpoint) and gateway-httproute sources. It creates proxied DNS records for SECRET_DOMAIN with k8s. TXT prefix for ownership verification, targeting the external gateway. Cloudflare API token is stored in cloudflare-dns-secret.

AdGuard DNS integration syncs internal service DNS records to AdGuard Home instance at http://192.168.50.1:3000 using a webhook provider (ghcr.io/muhlba91/external-dns-provider-adguard:v11.1.1). It watches gateway-httproute and gateway-tlsroute sources, targeting the internal gateway, with credentials stored in adguard-dns-secret.

k8s-gateway provides internal DNS resolution for Kubernetes resources, exposing a LoadBalancer service on static IP 192.168.50.11 assigned via Cilium IPAM annotation. It watches HTTPRoute and Service resources, generating DNS records for SECRET_DOMAIN with 1-second TTL, enabling cluster-internal service discovery.

CoreDNS provides standard Kubernetes service discovery with cluster IP 10.43.0.10, running 2 replicas scheduled on control-plane nodes. It includes plugins for errors, health, ready, hosts, kubernetes, autopath, forward, cache, loop, reload, loadbalance, prometheus, and log, with custom host mappings for internal services and upstream forwarding to /etc/resolv.conf.

Tailscale operator (v1.98.9) provides secure mesh networking with OAuth authentication from tailscale-secret. The operator is configured with hostname 'tailscale' and API server proxy enabled. Egress proxy functionality enables accessing external Tailnet resources via ExternalName services annotated with Tailnet IPs.

External ingress traffic flows from users through DNS resolution to Cloudflare Tunnel endpoint, then via Cloudflare Edge to the tunnel, which forwards HTTP/2 traffic to the external Cilium Gateway (192.168.50.13). The gateway routes HTTPRoutes to backend services via Cilium's BPF load balancing. Cloudflare External DNS manages DNS records for exposed services.

Internal service traffic resolves via k8s-gateway (192.168.50.11) or CoreDNS (10.43.0.10) to the internal Cilium Gateway (192.168.50.12) or service ClusterIPs. The gateway routes HTTPRoutes to backend services through Cilium's BPF load balancing. AdGuard DNS syncs records to AdGuard Home for local resolution.

The cluster uses distinct IP ranges: 10.42.0.0/16 for pod network (Cilium native routing), 10.43.0.0/16 for service network with CoreDNS at 10.43.0.10, 192.168.50.13 for external gateway, 192.168.50.12 for internal gateway, 192.168.50.11 for k8s-gateway DNS, 192.168.50.10 for cluster VIP and qBittorrent egress, all within the 192.168.50.0/24 local network.
